correctness.rationale: Every length-(G+2) minimal absent word has a repeated length-G interior. The proof classifies precisely the two length-G repeated factors and every permitted predecessor/successor context. The complete absence of length-(G+1) repetitions rules out all longer minimal absent words. The recursive maximum zero-run and longest proper border properties are proved directly. Literal-factor checker.py independently reproduces the two longest repeats, the absence of longer repeats, and the three extremal missing words for levels 2–7, with full MAW-length enumeration for levels 2–4. Finite tests are not used as an infinite proof.
